title: MV Overlapping footstep sound effects/ using Yanfly footstep sound plugin

posts.author: aobara22
posts.body: I am using the Yanfly plugin that enables custom footstep sounds, and I wanted to use a multiple second long footstep audio. Is there a way for me to stop the audio from playing when the player stops moving? As of now when I use it the audio continues to play and just overlaps each time I take a step. I'm not sure if/how the parallel process method works with the plugin I'm using. I am fairly new to Rpgmaker mv so my apologies if this is a simple issue lol.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Logically, you would have that problem with any method you use, a plugin or a parallel process.
The point of footstep sounds is they play each "footstep" (with RPG Maker, usually each tile you move) and that happens more than once a second.
If you choose to assign a sound effect that plays for longer than that, logically they'll overlap.
If you set the whole thing up via parallel process, it should be trivial to put a cutoff in there (if the player is moving, play footstep sound, else Stop SE), but I really don't think hearing your SE(s) cut off in the middle is going to be any better than hearing it play for too long.
You probably want to just use a footstep sound.
